id.description: The Id of the loyalty activitiy in the Tyro Connect system.

locationId.description: The Id of the location as specified by the Tyro Connect system.

memberId.description: The identifier of the member who is associated with this activity. This value corresponds to the origin.memberId provided during member registration.

paymentId.description: Payment Identifier generated from the payment source. It refers to the `transaction.receipt` (from Tyro eCommerce APIs) or otherwise referred to as the RRN.

mode.description: EFTPOS integration type. It will always be `NOT_APPLICABLE` for `ONLINE` payments.

allOf.description: This is the amount paid by the card holder for their goods and/or services. This amount does not include any tip, surcharge, or cash out.
If the cardholder withdrew cash as part of the transaction this value represents how much cash was given to the cardholder.
If the cardholder left a tip this value represents how much the tip was.
If the cardholder was charged a surcharge this value represents how much the surcharge was.
The total amount that was paid by the cardholder.

locationId.description: This is the Tyro Connect defined location Id. It is a globally unique identifier that is used to identify a merchants individual site

origin.description: Identifiers and reference numbers that were generated by the POS.

saleId.description: The Id of the sale generated by the POS. This value should allow for partner systems to reconcile this sale with the POS.

locationId.description: The Id of the store according to the POS

locationName.description: This is the human readable name of the location.

source.description: Information about the source of the sale.

type.description: An enum describing the source type of the sale.

other.description: The source of the sale if the source type is OTHER.

type.description: An enum describing what kind of sale took place.

status.description: An enum describing the status of the sale. In the future the API will support more values for this field.

openedZonedDateTime.description: The time the sale was opened on the POS. The format of the date time is the notation as defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6)

closedZonedDateTime.description: The time the sale was closed on the POS. The format of the date time is the notation as defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6)

register.description: Information about which register in the venue was used

staff.description: Details about the staff member who performed the transaction

id.description: The id of the staff member in the POS system. Please **do not** put the staff members name here

section.description: The section within the venue where the sale took place.

id.description: The POS system's Id of the section

name.description: The readable name of the section. E.g. Front bar, drive through for hospitality or for retail men's clothes, womens shoes etc.

table.description: Optional information about the table where in the venue the sale took place.

number.description: The table number or table id. This field accepts alphanumeric characters e.g `MAIN-33`

seats.description: The number of PAX where were seated at the table

bookingId.description: The booking ID defined by Tyro Connect to identify a reservation

allOf.description: The total amount (in cents) of tax collected for this sale by the merchant.

acquirer.description: Details about the financial instituition that processed the payment. This object is only supplied when the `method` is `EFTPOS`

name.description: The name of the Financial Institution that processed the payment. If it was Tyro Payments who processed the transaction, this value is `TYRO`

transactionReference.description: A reference number that can be used to look up the transaction in the acquirer's system.

terminalId.description: The Financial Institution's id of the payment terminal that performed the transaction

allOf.description: The amount (in cents) being paid for the goods and services
The tip amount added on top of the goods and services
The cashout amount requested on top of the goodsAndServicesAmount
The surcharge amount (in cents) charged by the merchant to process the payment method
The total (in cents) of this sale. It must calculate to: sum(items[].total) - discounts + surcharges
The subtotal (in cents) of this sale. It must calculate to: sum(items[].total)

line-item.title: Line Item
line-item.description: This object represents a line item within a sale.

id.description: A unique id representing the item within the overall order, i.e. 2 of the same items will have unique ids.

sku.description: The Id of the item that is aligned with the Id of the item in the POS.

modifiers.description:
A list of modifications to be made to the parent item.
Each object in this array is a [`Line Item`](#/components/schemas/line-item)

allOf.description: The single unit price (in cents) including tax but excluding discounts (if any)
The single unit amount (in cents) of tax collected by the merchant
The single unit cost (in cents) paid by the merchant
The single unit amount (in cents) of tax paid by the merchant

discounts.description: A list of discounts applied to the line item (this is not a per unit discount). e.g if the line item has a quantity of 3, and each item has a 20 cent discount, you could include one discount of 60 cents in the list, or three 20 cent discounts in the list.

sale.title: Sale info
sale.description: Provides additional information about the sale. Only present when top-level sale type is COMBINATION. Allows a POS to record a sale that contains item/s that are returned or exchanged as part of the sale.

surcharges.description: A list of surcharges applied to the line item (this is not a per unit surcharge). e.g if the line item has a quantity of 5, and each item has a $2 surcharge, you could include one surcharge of $10 in the list, or five $2 surcharges in the list.

quantity.description: The number of units of this item in the sale. It can be fractional.

allOf.description: The amount (in cents) of tax collected by the merchant for this line item
The total (in cents) of this line item after tax, discounts, surcharges, modifiers and rounding have been applied.

amount.description: This is the amount in smallest currency unit. e.g 12520 (in cents) is $125.20

description.description: A description of what this amount of money represents
